videos.description: Khabib & islam | @yusuf_088 & @𐱅𐰇𐰼𐰰  #islammakhachev #khabibnurmagomedov #nasheed #UFC #fyp                      The Careers of Khabib Nurmagomedov and Islam Makhachev 1. Khabib Nurmagomedov Khabib Nurmagomedov is one of the greatest fighters in the history of mixed martial arts (MMA). He was born on September 20, 1988, in Dagestan, Russia. From a young age, he trained in wrestling, judo, and combat sambo under the guidance of his father, Abdulmanap Nurmagomedov. His professional career * 2008: Khabib began his professional MMA career. * 2012: He joined the UFC and quickly became a rising star. * 2018: He defeated Al Iaquinta to become the UFC Lightweight Champion. * 2018: He defeated Conor McGregor in one of the most famous fights in UFC history. * 2019: He defeated Dustin Poirier to defend his championship. * 2020: He defeated Justin Gaethje and announced his retirement. Khabib retired with an undefeated professional record of 29 wins and 0 losses. Fighting style and legacy Khabib was famous for his wrestling, ground control, and ability to dominate his opponents. He was extremely difficult to defeat because of his strength, technique, and discipline. After his father’s death, Khabib decided to retire. He later became a coach and helped other fighters develop their careers. Today, he is remembered as one of the most dominant UFC champions of all time. 2. Islam Makhachev Islam Makhachev was born on October 27, 1991, in Dagestan, Russia. Like Khabib, he grew up training in martial arts, particularly wrestling and combat sambo. He trained alongside Khabib and became one of his closest teammates. His professional career * 2010: Islam began his professional MMA career. * 2015: He made his UFC debut. * 2022: He defeated Charles Oliveira to become the UFC Lightweight Champion. * 2023: He defeated Alexander Volkanovski twice, including a knockout victory in their rematch. * 2024: He submitted Dustin Poirier to defend his lightweight title. * 2025: He defeated Renato Moicano before moving up to the welterweight division. * 2025: He defeated Jack Della Maddalena to become a UFC champion in a second weight division. * 2026: He continued his championship career in the welterweight division. Islam has established himself as one of the best MMA fighters of his generation. Fighting style and achievements Islam is known for his wrestling, sambo, submissions, and improved striking. He can control opponents on the ground and also compete effectively while standing. One of his biggest achievements is becoming a UFC champion in two different weight divisions. He has continued the legacy of Dagestani fighters and demonstrated exceptional technical ability. 3. The relationship between Khabib and Islam Khabib and Islam are close friends, training partners, and members of the same Dagestani fighting team. They share a similar martial arts background and learned important lessons from Abdulmanap Nurmagomedov. After Khabib retired, he became a mentor and coach for Islam, helping him prepare for major fights. Both fighters believe in discipline, hard work, respect, and dedication to training. 4. Conclusion Khabib Nurmagomedov became a legend by retiring undefeated and dominating the UFC lightweight division. Islam Makhachev followed a similar path and achieved another major milestone by becoming a champion in two weight divisions. Khabib built an extraordinary legacy, and Islam has continued that legacy while creating his own history. Both fighters are excellent examples of how discipline, determination, and technical skills can lead to success in MMA.

videos.description: Khabib Nurmagomedov — a fighter whose legacy was built on discipline, control and an unbreakable mindset. Born on September 20, 1988, in Sildi, Dagestan, Khabib grew up surrounded by wrestling and combat sports. Under the guidance of his father, Abdulmanap Nurmagomedov, he developed the mentality and skills that eventually took him to the highest level of MMA. He entered the UFC and went on to become UFC Lightweight Champion, finishing his professional career with an undefeated 29–0 record. But numbers don’t tell the whole story. Khabib was known for his relentless pressure, wrestling and ability to impose his style on opponents. Fight after fight, he stayed composed and trusted the work he had put in. His mindset was simple: Work hard. Stay disciplined. Respect the process. You don’t become great because you’re motivated every day. You become great because you continue when the motivation disappears. When training gets hard — keep going. When people doubt you — keep going. When nobody is watching — keep going. Because discipline is doing what needs to be done, even when you don’t feel like doing it. Don’t look for shortcuts. Build yourself. One day. One workout. One fight. One step at a time. Kill Your Limits. Speaker: Khabib Nurmagomedov #Khabib #KhabibNurmagomedov #UFC #MMA #Eagle
